title: 第二百三十二章 结界第二百三十一 夜袭沙忍营地
lines: 第二百三十二章结界
“不错的直觉！”用词虽然带有称赞之意，但语气却十分平淡。
听到突然出现的声音，叶苍眼瞳一缩，随即撤步后跃，待到转过身时，却见一个身着黑色风衣的俊朗青年站在不远处，脸上泛着若隐若现的笑意。
“暗影幽蝶！”叶苍的语气中带有愠怒，但心中却已经警惕万分。
而此时叶苍营帐的爆炸声已经惊醒了周围营帐的忍者，众沙忍纷纷从营帐中纵跃而出，数十位上忍顿时站在夜天云的面前，只是远处营地中的忍者们却并未在第一时间出现，他们将叶苍营帐的爆炸声当做了火焰分身的最后一次爆炸声。
纵然是忍者，也很难逃脱潜意识的束缚。
感应到了远处营地中依旧滞留的大批忍者，夜天云的眼中闪过一丝喜意。
虽然此时他也是孤身面对着二三十位上忍，但要比几日前叶苍动辄率领数百名忍者的情况要好的多。
“今日你终于现身了，暗影幽蝶，鬼丸大爷要扒了你的皮！”鬼丸咧开了嘴，眼中充斥着森然的杀意。
夜天云淡淡一笑，戏谑的说道：“可惜了，我今天玩儿够了，明晚再来。”随即瞬间消失。
看着突然消失的夜天云，众人心中不由得吸了口凉气，那是真正的瞬间消失。
“果然是隐遁空间的血迹。”风尘一脸严肃的说道。
而叶苍的脸色更是难看无比，连续被戏耍了十天，任谁此时也都到了爆发的边缘。
“再见啦！”夜天云突然现身在远处的草丛中，笑着向一众沙忍挥了挥手。
“混帐东西！”叶苍将银牙咬的咔咔作响，冷声道：“追，今日定要将暗影幽蝶杀死！”
“是。”身为领队的叶苍如今都已经达到了爆发的边缘，其余上忍的心中自然更加怒不可遏，纷纷脚下发力，向夜天云猛冲过去。
看着狂奔而来的沙忍，夜天云脸上的笑意更甚，双手高速结印，如同蝴蝶穿花一般。
“火遁，豪火灭却！”一道蔓延百米的火墙顿时涌出，众位沙忍心头一惊。
不过毕竟都是上忍，只是惊诧了瞬间便稳下了心神，接着几位上忍从人群中冲到前方，纷纷双手结印。
“水遁，水流壁。”
虽然风之国地处沙漠之中，但依旧有着一些忍者修习了水遁，虽然不甚精奥，但七八位上忍的水遁结合在一起，足以挡住夜天云的豪火灭却了。
而且，此时夜天云的豪火灭却也未发挥到极致，他志在诱敌，也不愿意多耗费查克拉。
事实上开了八门后的他查克拉已经飙升到了一个恐怖的境地，加之精神力强大，每一分查克拉都被成倍的发挥出来，若是两方叠加，此时夜天云的查克拉量绝对是堪比尾兽。
而且，这还不算夜天云每日向他衣服中的阴封印储存的查克拉。

Chapter 232: Enchantment
"Good intuition!" Although the wording was meant to be complimentary, the tone was very bland.
Hearing the sudden sound, Ye Cang's eyes narrowed and he immediately stepped back. When he turned around, he saw a handsome young man in a black windbreaker standing not far away, with a faint smile on his face.
"Shadow Butterfly!" Ye Cang's tone was sulky, but he was extremely vigilant in his heart.
At this time, the explosion in Ye Cang's camp had awakened the ninjas in the surrounding camps. The sand ninjas jumped out of the camp one after another. Dozens of jounin immediately stood in front of Ye Tianyun. However, the ninjas in the distant camp did not appear at the first time. They regarded the explosion in Ye Cang's camp as the last explosion of the flame clone.
Even if you are a ninja, it is difficult to escape the shackles of your subconscious.
Sensing the large number of ninjas still stranded in the camp in the distance, Ye Tianyun's eyes flashed with joy.
Although he was facing twenty or thirty jounin alone at this time, the situation was much better than a few days ago when Ye Cang frequently led hundreds of ninjas.
"Today you finally showed up, Shadow Butterfly, Uncle Onimaru is going to skin you!" Onimaru grinned, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
Ye Tianyun smiled faintly and said jokingly: "It's a pity. I've had enough fun today. I'll come back tomorrow night." Then he disappeared instantly.
Looking at Ye Tianyun who suddenly disappeared, everyone couldn't help but take a breath. It was a real instant disappearance.
"Sure enough, it's the blood stains in the hiding space." Feng Chen said with a serious face.
And Ye Cang's face was even more ugly. He had been teased for ten days in a row, and everyone was on the verge of breaking out.
"Goodbye!" Ye Tianyun suddenly appeared in the grass in the distance, smiling and waving to the sand ninjas.
"You bastard!" Ye Cang gritted his silver teeth and said coldly: "Chasing, I will definitely kill the Shadow Butterfly today!"
"Yes." Ye Cang, who is the team leader, has now reached the edge of explosion. The other jonins are naturally even more furious, and they all use their feet to rush towards Ye Tianyun.
Seeing the sand ninja running towards him, the smile on Ye Tianyun's face became even bigger, and he formed seals with his hands at high speed, like a butterfly piercing a flower.
"Fire Escape, great fire extinguishment!" A wall of fire that spread hundreds of meters suddenly burst out, and all the Sand Ninjas were shocked.
But they were all jounin after all. They were just shocked and calmed down for a moment. Then several jounin rushed to the front from the crowd and formed seals with their hands.
"Water escape, water flow wall."
Although the Kingdom of Wind is located in the desert, there are still some ninjas who have practiced water escape. Although it is not very sophisticated, the water escape of seven or eight jounin combined is enough to stop Ye Tianyun's powerful fire from extinguishing.
Moreover, Ye Tianyun's powerful fire extinguishing power had not yet reached its full potential at this time. He was determined to lure the enemy and was unwilling to spend more chakra.
In fact, after opening the eighth gate, his chakra has soared to a terrifying level. Coupled with his strong mental power, every chakra is doubled. If the two parties are superimposed, Ye Tianyun's chakra amount at this time is definitely comparable to that of a tailed beast.
Moreover, this does not count the chakra that Ye Tianyun stores in the Yin seal in his clothes every day.
